caption: One start state q0 splits into two token classes: a letter or underscore begins an identifier at accepting state q1, a digit begins a number at accepting state q2, and both accepting states loop on more letters or digits. Walking rate2 up the top branch stays in q1 until the space, where no edge leaves, so the lexer stops and emits ID(rate2).

spec.aria: State q0 branches on a letter or underscore to accepting state q1, which recognises rate2 as an identifier, or on a digit to accepting state q2, which recognises 2 as an unsigned integer; both accepting states loop on their allowed characters.
